content.short: Aboard Exchange is an order book-based decentralized derivatives protocol offering perpetuals and options on Arbitrum.
content.description: Aboard Exchange is a comprehensive decentralized derivatives platform initially launched on Arbitrum, offering a professional order book-based trading experience. It supports a wide array of products, including token perpetuals, index perpetuals, and options with up to 25x leverage. By utilizing a sophisticated cross-margin system, the protocol enhances capital efficiency while minimizing liquidation risks for traders. With its native ABE token driving governance and utility, Aboard bridges the gap between centralized exchange performance and decentralized security for all institutional and retail users.
